blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a 1955 MNRF transect survey (contour features dated 1955-01-01; year confirmed via the LIO bathymetry index). Muskellunge confirmed (ARA + Broad-scale Monitoring); cold, clear (Secchi 8.2 m) shield lake.
